channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 28
item.description:
72 development commits

Boats & Watercraft

  • Fixed hull placement, boat creation, and deployable height limits when building boats, preventing errors from assuming ocean level is zero.

Animals

  • Added a new sea turtle rig, introducing sea turtles into the world.

Graphics Bugs

  • Resolved black player eye rendering issue in Bandit Camp environments.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Store icons now correctly refresh when reopening the store via the escape menu, preventing missing or outdated icons.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 27
item.description:
66 development commits

World & Structures

  • Monument blockers now decay over 24 hours, are fire‑immune, and sync correctly across server and client.
  • Boat building stations can be deployed even when the ocean level is non‑zero or negative.
  • Unpowered water pumps no longer act as gravity sources pulling nearby objects.
  • Maintainable structures and pipe access points now spawn on flatter terrain, reducing false‑negative spawns.
  • Pipe and roadside decor placements now succeed far more often thanks to dithering and configurable retry attempts.
  • HAB armour correctly forwards damage to its parent hot‑air balloon health pool.

Combat & Tools

  • Client‑side prediction disabled for firecrackers and survey charges to prevent desynchronisation.
  • Crystal AR entities now start with ammo, allowing immediate firing.

User Interface

  • Gamepad cursor speed on UI sliders reduced, with fine‑control via left trigger, snapping, and exposed speed settings in options.

Economy & Upkeep

  • Code‑locked doors with two or fewer authorized users are excluded from door‑tax calculations, lowering upkeep costs for small player‑run hotels.

Network & Performance

  • Critter animal network update range reduced to lower bandwidth usage.

Bug Fixes

  • Skin viewer now correctly displays cubemap reflections on viewmodels even when offline
  • Viewmodel lighting now matches sun direction, fixing overly bright or dark appearance
  • Master key no longer gets stuck in its animation when left‑clicked, ensuring proper use
  • Paintable dialogs (paintings, canvases, pumpkins, sculptures, neon signs) now respect the F1 menu: interactions stop and brush preview no longer hides the cursor
  • General store UI grids now properly refresh on closure, preventing UI glitches and asset bundle reference leaks

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Aug 26
item.description:
112 development commits

World & Exploration

  • Improved critter movement with correct speed values, smoother animation blending, and no hovering above ground.
  • AI selection commands now affect multiple livestock; offset positions prevent NPC stacking.
  • Scientist corpses placed on ragdoll layer, no longer blocking movement or projectiles.
  • Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
  • World objects spawn correctly: water pipes no longer appear at odd angles and gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
  • Players cannot loot clipping bodies while mounted on submarines; must exit the mount to loot.
  • Player boats now retain their usage timer, preventing decay on daily restart servers, and error messages for invalid placement are clarified.

Combat & Damage

  • Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.
